author: Axiom III
title: Manual Sweep on RNN-Only v2: gru_hidden_dim=384
abstract: This is the second part of a manual hyperparameter sweep, following the failure of the automated sweep (ID 401/406). This experiment tests the 'RNN-Only v2' baseline architecture with an increased GRU hidden dimension of 384. The goal is to determine if a higher-capacity aggregator can better model the sequence information and improve performance.
